1_blocking_miss_fn.description: True match never admitted into candidate set (script transliteration, missing building number, extreme abbreviation)

2_threshold_scoring_fn.description: True match in candidate pool, but confidence score fell between 0.45 and 0.579 (below tau=0.58)

3_model_high_confidence_fp.description: Distinct businesses sharing generic name (e.g. 'National Traders') and approximate address/pin

4_feature_failure.description: Severe token corruption or OCR truncation in building numbers

5_singleton_failure_fp.description: Anchor has 0 true matches, but model predicted 1 low-confidence candidate, dropping score to 0.0

6_multi_match_failure.description: Entity has >8 matches and top-8 cap truncated 9th+ valid branch match
